newCodeRationale: The donors do not implement the approved optional Laravel boundary. New delivery code composes existing AccessContext, RequestBoundary, HostProfile, AdapterRegistry and CLI Kernel/Response rather than duplicating policy or application use cases. HostApplication, HttpIdentity, JobIdentity, JobHandler and RouteRegistrar are explicit host composition seams. No vendor dependency enters core/root, no autodiscovery metadata or install hook is added, and no worker/scheduler/model call starts at boot. The one-route host example is a delivery example; the optional HTTP package owns the full HTTP API.

Delivery tests need no external database/model backend: SQL is published without execution. Existing core application/lifecycle/disclosure persistence remains responsible for authoritative tenant and immutable identity checks.
Host applications must bind real authentication, route, application and durable job handlers. The optional HTTP package's full endpoint/schema surface is not implemented by this provider item.
The host starts queue workers/outbox scheduling explicitly. Python worker subprocess execution remains in existing core application adapters.
V1, independent review, plan recording and commit are coordinator-owned and were not launched.
